title: Keychron K2 Wireless Mechanical Keyboard, Hot-swappable, RGB Backlight, Gateron Brown Switches, Aluminum Frame — Mac & Windows
bullets: Connect via Bluetooth 5.1 to three devices or use the included USB-C cable for near-zero latency gaming.
Hot-swappable sockets let you change Gateron switches without soldering — browns pre-installed for tactile typing.
Compact 75% layout keeps arrow keys and function row while freeing desk space versus full-size boards.
South-facing RGB backlight with per-key customization in Keychron Launcher (wired mode).
Aluminum frame with ABS keycaps; Mac and Windows key legends printed so one board covers both OS layouts.
Up to 240 hours battery life with backlight off; recharge over USB-C.
Compatible with Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iPadOS.
description: The Keychron K2 is a 75% wireless mechanical keyboard popular with developers who want Mac-friendly layouts without giving up Windows shortcuts.
Hot-swap sockets make switch experimentation easy — try linear reds for gaming or silent pinks for shared offices without buying a new PCB.
Bluetooth multipoint remembers three hosts. A physical switch on the side flips Mac/Windows key mappings instantly.

aplus.heading: From the manufacturer
paragraphs: Keychron focuses on cross-platform mechanical keyboards with wireless convenience and repairable hot-swap designs.
Firmware and keymap tools are updated regularly through the Keychron Launcher web app.

reviews.author: Devan S.
reviews.title: Perfect Mac + Windows desk setup
reviews.body: Side OS switch is genius. Browns feel great for long coding sessions and Bluetooth to the MBP is rock solid.

reviews.author: Rita A.
reviews.title: Good value, stock stabs rattle
reviews.body: After clipping and lubing stabs it is quiet enough for open office. Out of the box they were a bit pingy.

reviews.author: Ben W.
reviews.title: Hot-swap is addictive
reviews.body: Swapped to silent reds in twenty minutes. No soldering iron required — exactly what I wanted.

reviews.author: Chloe F.
reviews.title: RGB software is wired-only
reviews.body: Fine once configured, but you must plug in USB-C to change effects. Wish wireless config worked.

qa.question: Are the switches hot-swappable on this version?
qa.answer: Yes. The K2 Version 2 with hot-swap sockets is the model listed here. Confirm "hot-swappable" on the variant title.

qa.question: Does it work with iPad?
qa.answer: Yes over Bluetooth. Use the iOS keyboard layout toggle in Settings when needed.

climatePledge.label: Climate Pledge Friendly
climatePledge.detail: Long-life hot-swap design helps reduce electronic waste.

customersSay.heading: Customers say
customersSay.summary: Developers like the Mac/Windows switch and wireless stability. Stock stabilizers may need lubing.
